resin-3d-printer.context: A boxy printer with a plate lifting a small printed object out of a shallow resin vat. Used for resin and SLA 3D printing, maker tools and manufacturing.

filament-spool.context: A round spool of wound filament with one loose strand trailing off the side. Used for 3D printer material, plastic filament stock and reels of wire.

3d-printer-nozzle.context: A heater block with a cone-shaped nozzle laying plastic onto stacked layers below. Used for FDM 3D printing, print head and extruder settings.

laser-engraver.context: An open gantry frame with a laser head firing a short beam onto a board. Used for laser engraving, cutting and etching machines in maker spaces.
